title: Luscious Glassy Indian Fermented Yogurt Biryani
description: Indulgent Bengali dish featuring lemongrass-takrai and fermented yogurt, perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Soak 1 cup of basmati rice in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the water and set the rice aside.
In a blender, blend 1 cup of fermented dahi, 2 stalks of lemongrass, and 2 tablespoons of takrai until smooth.
Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee in a large pan over medium heat.
Add 1 teaspoon of cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add 1 teaspoon of coriander powder, 1/2 teaspoon of red chili powder, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Mix well.
Add the blended dahi mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the soaked basmati rice to the pan and mix well.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan with a tight-fitting lid, and cook for 18-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
